note: The Saba film: Saba (Aurora, her voice in the app, at the normal pace) and the candidate (another Aura-2 voice). Saba's lines are cut the way the app cuts them for her voice (packages/ui/src/live/speechText.ts speechChunks), one file per piece, so the room plays exactly these files for its own requests. The saba-ack-* lines are her short acknowledgements (packages/ui/src/live/naturalVoice.ts ACKS); the film serves one of them.

lines.text: To start, tell me about a time you used data to change a product decision.
lines.caption: To start, tell me about a time you used data to change a product decision.

lines.text: At Juniper Logistics, most late deliveries came from the date we promised at checkout. So I built a delivery-time model, and made the case for showing a delivery window instead. Late deliveries fell eighteen percent in two quarters.
lines.caption: At Juniper Logistics, most late deliveries came from the date we promised at checkout. So I built a delivery-time model, and made the case for showing a delivery window instead. Late deliveries fell 18% in two quarters.

lines.text: When you made the case for a window, how did you convince the product team?
lines.caption: When you made the case for a window, how did you convince the product team?

lines.text: I ran a two-week test, split by city, with cancellations as the main metric. The numbers did the convincing.
lines.caption: I ran a two-week test, split by city, with cancellations as the main metric. The numbers did the convincing.

lines.text: That's all from me today, and your review is ready now.
lines.caption: That's all from me today, and your review is ready now.
